risks.risk: Drive type and exact machine model are not confirmed from the single partial photo; pricing could be wrong if it’s not the same class as the comparables.
risks.proof: Ask for photo(s) showing the full machine (front + side) including the motor/drive area and any model plate/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case comparable for a generic used sewing machine/industrial unit without confirmed direct-drive or exact model.

risks.risk: Functionality is unknown (no test run, no stitch sample). Motor may run but timing/needle/feed could be faulty.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of a full test: threading, running at speed, and a stitched fabric sample (straight stitch).
risks.if_unproven: Assume not fully working and price toward the lowest comparable.

risks.risk: Accessories/manual may be missing or incomplete.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo spread of every accessory and the manual cover/title page.
risks.if_unproven: Assume accessories/manual are incomplete and price toward the lower end.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in the photo (rust, worn feed dogs, bent needle bar, oil leaks).
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of needle area, feed dogs, presser foot, and any visible wear points.
risks.if_unproven: Assume average-worn used condition and price at the lower comparable.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the full machine (front, side, and back) including the motor/drive area to confirm direct-drive vs belt-drive.
Send a photo of the model plate/label (with brand and country-of-origin if present).
Send a short video test: threading + running + stitched fabric sample.
Send photos of all accessories laid out and the manual (cover + inside title page).
Close-ups of needle area/feed dogs/presser foot and any oil/rust/wear.
response.reason: With only one partial photo, the exact machine identity, drive type, and working condition (stitching/timing) are not provable, so a confident price pick would be unreliable.
